about: Biotech / drug value chain tracked on the Biotech tab (Adam, Oct 29 2026). Edit the ticker lists freely; a ticker may sit in more than one stage. demand = the biotech-spending gauges shown on top.

stages.name: Target & molecular design
stages.desc: Physics simulation, quantum mechanics, generative AI and target identification

stages.name: Lab automation & instruments
stages.desc: Liquid handlers, mass spectrometry, flow cytometry, sequencers and screeners

stages.name: Reagents & consumables
stages.desc: Antibodies, cell culture media, assay kits, DNA/RNA building blocks and animal models

stages.name: CROs (preclinical & clinical)
stages.desc: Phase I-III trials, patient recruitment, site management and preclinical testing

stages.name: Biomanufacturing & CDMO
stages.desc: Process engineering, bioreactors and filtration, drug packaging, API synthesis and batch scaling

stages.name: Clinical, regulatory & quality software
stages.desc: eTMF, clinical data management (CDMS), quality management (QMS), regulatory submissions

stages.name: Cold chain & distribution
stages.desc: Cryogenic shipping, ultra-low-temperature storage and specialty wholesalers

stages.name: Healthcare data & real-world evidence
stages.desc: Rx claims data, provider analytics, real-world evidence and AI on clinical data

stages.name: Brand & generic drug owners
stages.desc: The commercial owners of the drugs: big pharma, big biotech and generics
